MAP & Evaluation plan (high level)
- Owners:

  - FinBank: Sara (product owner), Procurement (PO & legal)
- Goals: verify sustained QPS at target concurrency mix, measure TTFT P50/95/99, measure tokens/sec and derive $/1M-token unit cost for hosted vs dedicated profiles

- Traffic shape & concurrency: sample provided by FinBank (expected median prompt length ~420 tokens, 20% long-tailed prompts >4k)
- Key metrics: tokens/sec, sustained QPS (1m window), TTFT (first token P50/P95/P99), end-to-end latency under 95% SLA window
- Data exchange: FinBank sends sample prompt bundle (S3 link) and a target concurrency profile by EOD 2027-08-09
- Deliverables & timeline:
  - 2027-08-10: Redwood runs baseline hosted test + dedicated baseline run (night window)
  - 2027-08-11: extended sustained runs (6h blocks) to establish steady-state tokens/sec and QPS
  - 2027-08-12: consolidated results, unit-econ draft, and suggested commit level (Hosted vs Dedicated)
  - 2027-08-13: review call to walk results and finalize action items
  - 2027-08-15: target PO execution (FinBank)
- Risks/contingencies: if sample traffic differs materially we will flag deviations; fallback plan is to run an additional 24h sustained test (adds 48h to timeline)

Uploading preliminary raw numbers from the first baseline runs — attached CSV (finbank-benchmark-raw.csv). Quick highlights / readout:

Baseline run config (hosted): 4xA100 equiv pool, open-llm-v2-32k, caching ON for repeated prefixes
- Steady-state tokens/sec (hosted baseline): 14,600 tok/s (measured over 1m windows during 6h run)
- Sustained QPS (hosted): 520 QPS at median prompt, 95p sustained QPS for traffic mix: 410 QPS
- TTFT (hosted): P50=78ms, P95=220ms, P99=430ms (first-token latency)

Dedicated baseline (4xA100 equiv reserved pool, quantized 8-bit):
- Steady-state tokens/sec (dedicated): 27,900 tok/s
- Sustained QPS (dedicated): 990 QPS median; 95p sustained QPS: 820 QPS
- TTFT (dedicated): P50=42ms, P95=110ms, P99=210ms

Unit econ (rough draft, raw compute only):
- Hosted: ~$18.70 per 1M input tokens (includes multi-tenant overhead & network egress assumptions)
- Dedicated: ~$6.30 per 1M input tokens (reserved capacity; excludes discounting and infra amortization)
- Notes: output token costs are ~0.6x input token cost given smaller model-side processing; final econ will include caching uplift and batching improvements

Observations and recommendations:
- Dedicated clearly outperforms hosted on tokens/sec and TTFT; if FinBank expects sustained >700 QPS we should recommend a dedicated commit to avoid cost spikes and fallback throttling
- For latency-sensitive paths keep an instance of dedicated with smaller batch sizes and aggressive prefix caching

I'm leaving the raw CSV attached. I will run a second set with a heavier long-tail mix tomorrow morning (Aug 11).

— Ben
Ben Carter
Principal SRE, Redwood Inference

Sara / Procurement — consolidated unit economics and recommended commit level (PDF attached). Executive summary:

Summary tables (compute-only, rounded)
- Hosted (production multi-tenant baseline): 18.7 $ / 1M input tokens
- Dedicated (reserved 4xA100 equiv): 6.3 $ / 1M input tokens (baseline reserved pricing)
- Expected blended (with caching & batching optimization): Hosted: ~14.2 $/1M, Dedicated: ~4.8 $/1M (after caching uplift, 20% fewer tokens processed)

Recommendation and ask:
- If FinBank wants to hit sustained 700-900 QPS with <P95 150ms, we recommend a Dedicated commit (initial 3-month reserved pool) and an on-call SLO response add-on.
- Suggested commercial: 15% ARR discount on Dedicated commits over 6 months; we can scope a 90-day pilot at a reduced commit level to start (pilot pricing in attached PDF).

Next steps we propose:
- FinBank confirms a desired commit tier or requests pilot by EOD 2027-08-12
- If confirmed, Redwood will generate a SOW + PO workbook and target onboarding week of 2027-08-16
